items.q: I'll never forget a place where we did play with Louie, had a manager by the name of Pierre Tallery, a Frenchman.

ctx.x: Cozy Cole endorses such and such drums.

That's right, and you don't know anything about it. Till somebody tells you about it, and then they start passing the buck, oh no, I didn't do this, and then it's too late then, they've got it out, they maybe sold some drums behind that. I'll never forget a place where we did play with Louie, had a manager by the name of Pierre Tallery, a Frenchman.
